definitions.explanation: A single minute of clock time or duration. Often used loosely for "a moment", as in {一分|いっぷん}{待|ま}って (hang on a second).

examples.japanese: あと{一分|いっぷん}です。
{一分|いっぷん}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{待|ま}って→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{電子|でんし}レンジ→電子レンジ：04973_denshirenji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{一分|いっぷん}⟦{温|あたた}めて→温める：02096_atatameru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜて→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Heat it in the microwave for one minute, then mix it well.

notes:
The counter ⟦{分|ふん}→分：00928_fun⟧ changes shape after certain numbers: いっぷん, ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ふん, さんぷん, よんぷん, ごふん, ろっぷん, ななふん, はっぷん, きゅうふん, じゅっぷん. Learners should memorise this set as a block rather than one number at a time.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一分間|いっぷんかん}: for one minute (duration)
- {一分|いっぷん}⟦{以内|いない}→以内：01317_inai⟧: within one minute
- {一分|いっぷん}{一秒|いちびょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{争|あらそ}う→争う：01866_arasou⟧: to be a race against the clock

USAGE:
The same characters read いちぶ mean "one part" or "one tenth", as in {一分|いちぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{隙|すき}→隙：10999_suki_gap⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (without the slightest opening). Context and reading, not the writing, tell the two apart.
